main.description: A passage the reader marked in a book, with an optional note. Carries enough locator detail to be restored into the reading app that created it.

book.description: AT-URI of the at.stim.reading.book record this highlight belongs to.

note.description: The reader's own note attached to the passage.

color.description: Highlight color name as the reading app knows it, e.g. yellow, green.

style.description: How the passage is drawn. Values follow KOReader's highlight styles.

locator.description: Where the passage sits in the file. Only meaningful against the same file bytes (see book identifiers.fileHash).

format.description: koreader-xpointer: start/end are crengine xpointers (reflowable formats). koreader-pdf: start/end are 'page:x:y' page-space coordinates (fixed-layout formats).

page.description: Page number on the creating device, continuous numbering. Device-dependent for reflowable formats.

pageLabel.description: Publisher page label when the book provides a page map; stable across devices.

context.description: Text immediately around the passage, for re-anchoring the highlight in a different edition (maps onto a W3C TextQuoteSelector).

generator.description: The client that wrote this record.
